```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(viridisLite)
library(ggrepel)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(scales)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Repo-relative paths: inputs from imports_stable/, outputs to analysis_outs/
repo_dir <- (function(d = normalizePath(getwd())) {
  while (!dir.exists(file.path(d, "imports_stable"))) {
    if (dirname(d) == d) stop("Could not find repo root (folder containing imports_stable/)")
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  d
})()
imports_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "imports_stable")
outs_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "analysis_outs", "02_combinatorial_screen_signalseq_SIG13")
dir.create(file.path(outs_dir, "plots"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
source(file.path(repo_dir, "functions/r_custom/plotting_fxns.R"))
theme_set(theme_Publication())

tab10_colors <- c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
                  "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf")

interaction_palette <- c("#808080","#D95F02","#E7298A","#1B9E77FF")
```

# Goal

Visualize specific interactions in a presentable way.

# Import

```{r}
interScored <- readr::read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG13/analysis_outs/glmGamPoi/interactions_scored_v3_glmGamPoi_0.05filter.csv")) %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = case_when(interaction_class == "additive over saturation" ~ "none",
                                       interaction_class == "buffering complete" ~ "buffering",
                                       is.na(interaction_class) ~ "none",
                                       TRUE ~ interaction_class)) %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = factor(interaction_class, levels = c("none","buffering","synergy negative","synergy positive"))) %>%
  mutate(lfc_expected = lfc_ligand1 + lfc_ligand2)

# inter-replicate correlations
conditionLfcRep <- readr::read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG13/analysis_outs/replicate_corr/replicate_correlation_singleLfc_0.2filter.csv"))
interLfcRep <- readr::read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG13/analysis_outs/replicate_corr/replicate_correlation_interactionLfc_0.2filter.csv"))
singleLfc <- readr::read_csv(file.path(imports_dir, "SIG13/analysis_outs/glmGamPoi/glmGamPoi_singleTerm_lfc_0.05filter.csv"))
```

# Filter and annotate data

```{r}
# define consistent ligands by pearson correlation of LFCs
consistentLigands <- conditionLfcRep %>%
  filter(pearson_corr > 0.5) %>%
  pull(condition)

inconsistentInteractions <- interLfcRep %>%
  filter(pearson_corr <= 0.25) %>%
  pull(interaction)

inconsistentInteractions
```

```{r}
# filter conditions for only consistent ligands
interScoredSig <- interScored %>%
  filter(interaction %in% consistentLigands) %>%
  filter(!interaction %in% inconsistentInteractions) %>%
  # remove _TGFB1 ligands as it is not active
  filter(!grepl("_TGFB1", interaction)) %>%
  # remove genes that are not significannt 
  filter(adj_pval_condition < 0.1 | interaction_class == "buffering")
```

# Overall Interaction Effect Viz

Here I will plot the most significant interaction effect for positive and negative synergies

```{r, fig.width=12}
# slice for most significant effect per synergy
geneSummary <- interScoredSig %>%
  filter(interaction_class %in% c("buffering","synergy positive","synergy negative")) %>%
  group_by(name, interaction_class) %>%
  slice_min(adj_pval_interaction, n = 1) %>%
  filter(adj_pval_interaction < 0.001) %>%
  mutate(logp = pmin(pmax(-log10(adj_pval_interaction), 0), 50)) # cap padj to 0–50

# plot max positive synergy
p1 <- geneSummary %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "buffering") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = lfc_expected,
    y = lfc_condition,
    color = logp,
  )) +
      geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
    scale_color_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd", 
      direction = 1, 
      limits = c(0, 50),   # Set upper limit to 50
      oob = scales::squish  # "Squish" values >50 into the max color
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +
    ggtitle("buffering\nmost significant hit per gene") +
    xlab("max additive LFC") +
    ylab("max true LFC") +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# plot max negative synergy 
p2 <- geneSummary %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "synergy negative") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = lfc_expected,
    y = lfc_condition,
    color = logp,
  )) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
    scale_color_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd", 
      direction = 1, 
      limits = c(0, 50),  
      oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +
    xlim(-4.2,3.2) +
    ylim(-4.2,0.5) +
    ggtitle("synergy negative\nmost significant hit per gene") +
    xlab("max additive LFC") +
    ylab("max true LFC") +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# plot max positive synergy
p3 <- geneSummary %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "synergy positive") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = lfc_expected,
    y = lfc_condition,
    color = logp,
  )) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
    scale_color_distiller(
      palette = "YlOrRd", 
      direction = 1, 
      limits = c(0, 50),   # Set upper limit to 50
      oob = scales::squish  # "Squish" values >50 into the max color
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +
    ggtitle("synergy positive\nmost significant hit per gene") +
    xlim(-2.7,6.5) +
    ylim(-2.7,6.5) +
    xlab("max additive LFC") +
    ylab("max true LFC") +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p1+p2+p3
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/most_sig_interaction_per_gene.pdf"))
```

# Interaction Class Overview

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
doubleStims <- c(
  "IL2_IL2",
  "IL4_IL4",
  "IL6_IL6",
  "IL12_IL12",
  "IFNG_IFNG",
  "TNF_TNF",
  "IL7_IL7",
  "IL21_IL21"
)

combinations_with_effects <- singleLfc %>%
  filter(adj_pval < 0.1) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n > 50) %>%
  pull(condition)

interScoredSig %>%
  # keep only your desired interactions
  filter(!str_detect(interaction, "linker")) %>%
  filter(!(interaction %in% doubleStims))  %>%
  filter(interaction %in% combinations_with_effects) %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "additive over saturation") %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = case_when(interaction_class == "buffering complete" ~ "buffering",
                                       TRUE ~ interaction_class)) %>%
  # count & compute proportions
  count(interaction, interaction_class, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "none") %>%
  # 1) sort interactions by total non-none proportion (desc)
  mutate(interaction = fct_reorder(interaction, proportion, .fun = sum, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction, y = proportion, fill = interaction_class)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = interaction_palette, breaks = c("none","buffering","synergy negative","synergy positive")) +
    labs(
      x     = "Ligand Combinations > 50 DEGs (excluding double stim and linkers)",
      y     = "Percent of DEGs",
      fill  = "Interaction Class",
      title = "Class Frequency per Interaction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )

ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/class_frequency_per_interaction_barplots.pdf"))
```

```{r}
interScoredSig %>%
  # keep only your desired interactions
  filter(!str_detect(interaction, "linker")) %>%
  filter(!(interaction %in% doubleStims))  %>%
  filter(interaction %in% combinations_with_effects) %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "additive over saturation") %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = case_when(interaction_class == "buffering complete" ~ "buffering",
                                       (interaction_class == "none") & (adj_pval_condition < 0.1) ~ "additive",
                                       TRUE ~ interaction_class)) %>%
  # count & compute proportions
  count(interaction, interaction_class, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "none") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = interaction_class, y = proportion, fill = interaction_class)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = interaction_palette, breaks = c("none","buffering","synergy negative","synergy positive")) +
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/class_frequency_boxplots.pdf"))
```

```{r}
interScoredSig %>%
  # keep only your desired interactions
  filter(!str_detect(interaction, "linker")) %>%
  filter(!(interaction %in% doubleStims))  %>%
  filter(interaction %in% combinations_with_effects) %>%
```

```{r}
temp <- interScoredSig %>%
  # keep only your desired interactions
  filter(!str_detect(interaction, "linker")) %>%
  filter(!(interaction %in% doubleStims))  %>%
  filter(interaction %in% combinations_with_effects) %>%
  filter(interaction_class != "additive over saturation") %>%
  mutate(interaction_class = case_when(interaction_class == "buffering complete" ~ "buffering",
                                       TRUE ~ interaction_class)) %>%
  # count & compute proportions
  count(interaction, interaction_class, name = "count") %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

no_interaction <- temp %>%
  filter(interaction_class == "none" & proportion == 100) %>%
  pull(interaction) %>%
  unique()

# get number of conditions with no interaction effects
length(no_interaction)/length(temp$interaction %>% unique())
```

# Interaction vs DEG Relationship

```{r}
interScoredSummary <- interScoredSig %>%
  group_by(interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    n_interactions = sum(interaction_class %in% c("synergy positive", "synergy negative"), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_degs_1 = sum(adj_pval_ligand1 < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_degs_2 = sum(adj_pval_ligand2 < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_degs_total = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(freq_interactions = n_interactions/n_degs_total) %>%
  filter(n_interactions > 20) %>%
  filter(n_degs_total > 50) %>%
  mutate(label_this = case_when(interaction %in% c("IL21_IL1B","IL6_IL1B") ~ interaction,
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_))

interScoredSummary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_degs_1, y = n_degs_2)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_interactions, color = log2(n_interactions))) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label_this)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Synergistic Interactions by DEGs")
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/interactions_synergistic_vs_deg_dotplot.pdf"))

interScoredSummary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_degs_total, y = freq_interactions)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label_this)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Synergistic Interactions by DEGs")
ggsave(file.path(outs_dir, "plots/interactions_synergistic_vs_deg_scatterplot.pdf"))
```

# TNF interaction viz

```{r}
# Define the specific order for the categories
cat_levels <- c("IL2_TNF", "IL4_TNF", "IL7_TNF", "IL6_TNF", "IL21_TNF", 
                "IL27_TNF", "IFNG_TNF", "TGFB1_TNF", "TNF_TNF", "single")

# subset and apply factor order
pattern <- "^(IL2|IL4|IL6|IL7|IL21|IL27|TGFB1|IFNG)_(TNF.*|linker)|^linker_TNF.*|^TNF_TNF.*"
interScoredSigTnf <- interScoredSig %>%
  filter(!grepl("TNFSF9|TNFSF14", interaction)) %>%
  filter(grepl(pattern, interaction)) %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    grepl("linker", interaction) ~ "single",
    grepl(pattern, interaction) ~ sub("^([^_]+)_TNF.*", "\\1_TNF", interaction),
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>%
  mutate(lfc_expected = case_when(category == "single" ~ lfc_condition,
                                  TRUE ~ lfc_expected)) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = cat_levels))
```


